name: cortico-world-fun
description: 娱乐时间 —— 给 Coopanion 桌宠十二处真能去逛的地方：游乐场、海洋馆、庙会、漫展、电影院、动物园、公园、电玩城、KTV、博物馆、猫咖、爬山。进门、逛摊位、买纪念品、拍张照、收摊记一笔。
author: 青

scripts.test: node test/venues.test.mjs && node test/state.test.mjs && node test/world.test.mjs
scripts.verify: node tools/fix-ps1-bom.mjs install.ps1 && node tools/check-prompt.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs && node tools/make-describe.mjs --check
scripts.prepublishOnly: node test/venues.test.mjs && node test/state.test.mjs && node test/world.test.mjs && node tools/check-prompt.mjs && node tools/smoke.mjs && node tools/make-describe.mjs --check && node tools/publish-check.mjs --online

zh.description: 给 Coo 十二处能真去逛的地方：游乐场、海洋馆、庙会、漫展、电影院、动物园、公园、电玩城、KTV、博物馆、猫咖、爬山。她说一声进门，一处一处地逛项目、抽个签、买点纪念品、拍张照，收摊时回执把这一趟收成一句话，接着去记进自己的日程。不装、不配、库挪走了也照样能逛。

en.description: Twelve places she can actually go: an amusement park, an aquarium, a temple fair, a fan convention, a cinema, a zoo, a park, an arcade, a karaoke box, a museum, a cat cafe, a hike. She walks in, wanders one spot at a time, buys a souvenir, takes a photo, and the closing receipt sums the trip up in one line she can log into her own day. No other extension required; it still works if the image library is gone.
